notes.title: Game release date
notes.notes:
Good day!  We are happy to inform you that we have completed the regulation of legal issues that we wrote about earlier and now there is nothing standing in the way of the game's release! The game will be released on July 16, 2025 after a series of formal checks by Steam. During the remaining month, we will focus our efforts on finding critical errors in the gameplay, and we also plan to complete a training module that will help you understand the game faster.



We also present to your attention the roadmap for the development of the project:



July-August 2025:  Making adjustments received after feedback from players



August-September 2025: Implementation of two new race tracks



Fall 2025:  Graphics and interface refinement



December 2025:  Global improvement of AI, introduction of new gameplay elements



Winter 2026:  Implementation of a visual car customization system



Spring 2026: Addition of a new era (1950-1960) and new car bodies



Summer 2026: Addition of trucks (via DLC)



Fall 2026: Adding the ability to customize the base and freely build



Winter 2027: Adding localization and other languages, exiting early access



We also allow the possibility of accelerating the implementation of this plan with a good financial return (will allow us to attract specialists to implement all our ideas)



Finally, we want to say that we are a team of enthusiasts and the main goal is to release a really good and interesting game with economic, design and racing elements.



This will be a dream project that we will bring to completion) But we can't do it without your help!



Thank you all for your attention and your advice, together we will bring the project to its logical conclusion!
